metadata.title: The $1 Wedding Ring
metadata.subtitle: Her aunt mocked my plain gold band at our engagement dinner—not knowing it's the Sovereign Bank master crest holding her mortgage.

nodes.text: 7:00 PM · Royal Lotus Banquet Room. You open a dark wooden box holding your grandfather’s plain Sovereign gold band—and Aunt Brenda bursts out laughing.
Hahaha! A plain brass ring from a $1 gumball machine?! Lily, break off this engagement right now! My husband’s friend is a banker!
Aunt Brenda, stop! I love {{player_name}}, not money! And that ring is a family heirloom!
Heirloom my foot! Here—let me toss this junk in the ice bucket so nobody gets embarrassed!
Good thing my husband is getting a $6M loan extension from Sovereign Private Bank tomorrow—we’ll buy Lily a real match!

nodes.prompt: Aunt Brenda reaches to grab the gold ring off the velvet:

options.label: Close the box & ask which bank she uses
options.player_reply_text: Careful, Aunt Brenda. Touching a Sovereign Crest ring without clearance is a $10M mistake.

options.label: Ping Julian to inspect her husband’s loan

nodes.text: Aunt Brenda rolls her eyes loudly, mocking you in front of twenty silent relatives.
Sovereign Crest? Hahaha! Next you’ll claim you own Sovereign Private Bank!
You tap one code on your phone. Within three seconds, Sovereign Bank’s VP Julian replies with a shocking red flag.
Chairman {{player_name}}, her husband’s $6M mortgage is 90 days delinquent—and he mortgaged Lily’s parents’ house without telling them!
You catch a glint of panic in Aunt Brenda’s eyes when her husband’s phone starts buzzing furiously.
Looks like Sovereign Private Bank just called your table, Aunt Brenda. Better answer.

nodes.headline: The Sovereign Crest
nodes.teaser_text: Aunt Brenda mocked the ring worth more than her whole neighborhood—right before Sovereign Bank’s VP walks through the door.

nodes.text: 7:15 PM · The banquet doors swing open. Sovereign Private Bank VP Julian strides in holding a crimson velvet ledger.
Julian confirms quietly: "I’m right outside the doors with the forged mortgage file. Ready on your signal, Chairman!"
Alert flashes: "Julian at the door with the delinquent mortgage & forged deed evidence."
Oh! Vice President Julian! Thank goodness you came—please tell my husband’s $6M loan extension is approved!

nodes.caption: Sovereign Vault Master Ring #01 — worn exclusively by the Chairman of Sovereign Private Bank.

nodes.prompt: Julian walks straight past Aunt Brenda and bows to you:

options.label: Let Julian introduce your real title
options.player_reply_text: Good evening, Julian. Aunt Brenda here thinks my ring came from a $1 machine.

options.label: Ask Julian about Lily’s parents’ deed live

nodes.text: Julian gasps in genuine horror and turns sharply toward Aunt Brenda’s table.
Madam, you just insulted the Master Crest of Chairman {{player_name}}—sole owner of Sovereign Private Bank!!
Julian opens the crimson folder in front of the entire family—revealing Aunt Brenda’s husband forged Lily’s father’s signature!
WHAT?! Uncle mortgaged my parents’ family home behind our backs?!
Aunt Brenda’s wine glass slips from her fingers, soaking her designer silk scarf.
C-Chairman?! {{player_name}}, I was only teasing! We’re practically family—please approve the extension!

nodes.headline: The Forged Mortgage
nodes.teaser_text: Aunt Brenda begs for mercy—unaware her husband just tried to swap your real Sovereign ring while nobody was looking.

nodes.text: 7:28 PM · Lily reaches for the wooden ring box—and gasps as she notices the band inside is light, hollow brass!
{{player_name}}, someone swapped your grandfather’s ring! Aunt Brenda’s husband just ran toward the parking garage!
Let him run. He doesn’t know Sovereign Ring #01 has a live GPS micro-beacon inside the gold band.

nodes.transcript: [checking tracking tablet] "Signal locked! He’s heading straight to an underground pawn broker on 4th Street!"

nodes.text: Honey, don’t pawn that ring—they’re calling the police!!

nodes.prompt: Aunt Brenda tries to block the banquet doors to buy her husband time:

options.label: Send GPS coordinates straight to police
options.player_reply_text: Julian, send the live beacon to the police patrol on 4th Street.

options.label: Freeze all of her husband’s bank cards now

nodes.text: Within ninety seconds, two patrol cars box Aunt Brenda’s husband in right outside the pawn shop.
Ring recovered intact! Suspect detained for grand theft and mortgage forgery!
You tap Freeze All Accounts. Aunt Brenda’s phone pings with twelve simultaneous "CARD SUSPENDED" alerts.
My cards?! Even our restaurant bill just declined!!
Aunt Brenda slumps into a chair as every relative realizes the truth about her "wealthy" lifestyle.
Wait, Chairman—when police searched his briefcase, they found a second forged deed for Lily’s grandmother’s orchard!

nodes.headline: The Second Forgery
nodes.teaser_text: Aunt Brenda wasn’t just trying to ruin your engagement—she was planning to steal Lily’s entire family inheritance by Friday.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Police bring the recovered Sovereign Ring back in a velvet pouch—along with the forged orchard contract.
Aunt Brenda, my parents took you in when you lost your business! How could you forge their names on TWO properties?!
We only needed a bridge until our crypto fund bounced back! Please, {{player_name}}, forgive the debt and we’ll vanish!

nodes.caption: Voided mortgage & forged orchard deed — both nullified by Sovereign Bank audit.

nodes.text: If they press charges on the orchard deed, I’m going to prison too...

nodes.prompt: Lily looks to you, her eyes glistening with resolve:

options.label: Nullify both forged mortgages & prosecute
options.player_reply_text: Zero forgiveness for stealing from Lily’s parents. Let the court decide.

options.label: Lock both family deeds safely in Lily’s trust

nodes.text: Julian stamps both fraudulent mortgages VOID on the spot as police escort Aunt Brenda out for questioning.
Lily’s parents’ home and orchard are 100% debt-free and protected!
You place both deeds into an unbreakable Sovereign Family Trust—guaranteeing nobody can ever mortgage them again.
My parents are crying tears of relief right now... thank you, {{player_name}}!
The tension melts from the banquet hall as Lily’s parents rush over to hug you tightly.
Now... can you actually put that "$1 ring" on my finger properly?

nodes.headline: The Ring Returns
nodes.teaser_text: Just as you slip the gold band onto Lily’s finger, Julian uncovers who was really behind her uncle’s "crypto fund."

nodes.text: 8:30 PM · Side lounge. Julian pulls up a wire trace showing Aunt Brenda’s husband didn’t lose $6M by accident—he was targeted.
Julian reveals: "The ‘banker friend’ Aunt Brenda bragged about is actually running a Ponzi ring targeting Sovereign clients!"
Alert flashes: "Aunt Brenda’s ‘banker match’ for Lily is a wanted Ponzi scammer!"
So she wanted to break up my engagement to set Lily up with the very con artist who drained her own husband’s account?!

nodes.transcript: [shuddering] "Wait—he’s supposed to meet Aunt Brenda in the hotel lobby in ten minutes to ‘introduce himself’ to me!"

nodes.prompt: The Ponzi scammer is walking straight into your hotel lobby:

options.label: Alert police to arrest him at the lobby doors
options.player_reply_text: Let’s give him a VIP welcome—with handcuffs.

options.label: Trace & freeze his entire $40M Ponzi wallet

nodes.text: Plainclothes officers intercept the fake banker the instant he steps off the escalator holding roses.
Target cuffed! Forty victims are getting justice tonight!
Sovereign’s cyber-compliance desk freezes his clearing wallets mid-transfer, locking $40M for victim restitution!
$40M recovered! Financial crime division just sent you a commendation!
You watch from the mezzanine as the con artist is led out in handcuffs—ending the scam ring for good.
You protected my parents, saved forty strangers, AND still made it back in time for dessert.

nodes.headline: The Whole Family Knows
nodes.teaser_text: With the scammer caught and the deeds safe, the engagement banquet turns into the night of a lifetime.

nodes.text: 9:30 AM · Sovereign Private Bank HQ. Victim restitution checks go out while Lily’s parents tour the vault with proud smiles.
All forty Ponzi victims just received 100% refunds! Your grandfather’s ring is trending across every finance paper!
Even my cousins who laughed at Table 1 are texting me asking for wedding invitations now!

nodes.transcript: [chuckling softly] "Tell them only the people who stood by us before the reveal make the VIP guest list."

nodes.text: I’m so sorry, Lily... I let greed blind me.

nodes.prompt: Julian asks how you want to celebrate the engagement:

options.label: Host it at Lily’s grandmother’s blooming orchard
options.player_reply_text: Right under the orchard trees we just saved.

options.label: Launch a free anti-scam fund for seniors

nodes.text: Lily’s eyes light up with pure joy—no five-star ballroom could beat her grandmother’s sunlit orchard.
That’s the most romantic idea ever!!
You launch the Sovereign Shield Initiative—protecting elderly families nationwide from mortgage and crypto scams.
A true legacy, Chairman {{player_name}}!
Sunlight catches the plain gold band on Lily’s finger—humble on the outside, priceless in heart.
One month till the orchard wedding—ready?

nodes.headline: Countdown To Forever
nodes.teaser_text: One month later, white blossoms bloom across the saved orchard for the wedding of the century.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Sunlit Orchard. String quartets play under white petals as Lily walks down the aisle wearing the Sovereign gold band.
Not a single snob in sight—just genuine love and cheering family!
Best "$1 ring" in the universe. I love you, {{player_name}}.
Forever starts right now.

nodes.prompt: The officiant smiles: "You may kiss the bride!"

options.label: Kiss Lily beneath the falling blossoms
Release 100 golden sky lanterns at dusk

nodes.text: Applause and petals shower down as the golden sunset wraps around you both.
Happiest day of my life!
A hundred golden lanterns drift upward over the orchard, lighting the twilight sky.
Like a fairy tale! Congratulations to you both!
From a mocked gold band to a love tested by fire—your forever shines brighter than gold.
Just getting started, Mrs. {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: Honeymoon Horizon
nodes.teaser_text: One final postcard from Zurich closes the legend of the $1 Wedding Ring.

nodes.text: 6:00 PM · Lake Geneva Balcony. You and Lily clink cocoa mugs overlooking snow-capped peaks.
Quick update from home: Sovereign Shield already stopped twelve scams this week!
Now that’s what real banking power is for.

nodes.transcript: [giggling softly] "Put the phone down, Chairman—it’s our honeymoon!"

nodes.text: Best wife in the world.

nodes.prompt: Switch your phone to Airplane Mode:

options.label: Watch the alpine sunset together
options.player_reply_text: Phone off. Just you and me.

options.label: Give Julian a paid month off too

nodes.text: Golden light spills across Lake Geneva as peace settles over your new life.
Perfect.
Julian cheers over text before you power down—everyone earned a happy ending.
Best boss on Earth!! Enjoy Geneva!!
The plain gold ring catches the alpine twilight—proof that true worth never needs a diamond tag.
Worth more than all the gold in Zurich.

nodes.headline: Epilogue · Alpine Glow
nodes.teaser_text: One final sunrise over the Alps seals the sweetest karma in family history.

nodes.text: 8:00 AM · Alpine Sunrise. You wake to fresh mountain air and Lily’s warm smile beside you.
Morning, Chairman! Ready for breakfast by the lake?
Only if you promise never to trade my "$1 ring" for a fancy diamond.
Lucky me.

nodes.prompt: Step onto the sunlit lakeside terrace:

options.label: Hold Lily’s hand & enjoy the sunrise

nodes.text: Sunlight dances across the blue lake as your new chapter shines bright.
To forever, {{player_name}}!
Warm espresso clinks against the crisp alpine breeze—pure perfection.
Best morning ever!
Truth won, greed lost, and love proved priceless.
True gold never fades.

nodes.headline: Finale · Priceless
nodes.teaser_text: The scheming aunt and Ponzi ring are behind bars, the family deeds are safe, and true love conquered all.
